title: GyroSwin: 5D Surrogates for Gyrokinetic Plasma Turbulence Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2510.07314v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nuclear fusion plays a pivotal role in the quest for reliable and sustainable energy production. A major roadblock to viable fusion power is understanding plasma turbulence, which significantly impairs plasma confinement, and is vital for next-generation reactor design. Plasma turbulence is governed by the nonlinear gyrokinetic equation, which evolves a 5D distribution function over time. Due to its high computational cost, reduced-order models are often employed in practice to approximate turbulent transport of energy. However, they omit nonlinear effects unique to the full 5D dynamics. To tackle this, we introduce GyroSwin, the first scalable 5D neural surrogate that can model 5D nonlinear gyrokinetic simulations, thereby capturing the physical phenomena neglected by reduced models, while providing accurate estimates of turbulent heat transport. translated_title: GyroSwin：用于回旋动理学等离子体湍流模拟的5D代理模型
translated_abstract: 核聚变在追求可靠且可持续的能源生产中起着关键作用。实现可行聚变发电的一大障碍是理解等离子体湍流，它会显著削弱等离子体约束，并对下一代反应堆设计至关重要。等离子体湍流由非线性回旋动理学方程控制，该方程随时间演化一个5维分布函数。由于其计算成本极高，实践中通常采用降阶模型来近似湍流能量输运。然而，这些模型忽略了完整5维动力学所特有的非线性效应。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GyroSwin，这是首个可扩展的5D神经代理模型，能够对5D非线性回旋动理学模拟进行建模，从而捕捉被降阶模型所忽略的物理现象，同时提供准确的湍流热输运估计。GyroSwin（i）将层次化视觉Transformer扩展到5D，（ii）引入了跨……
tldr: 本文提出GyroSwin，首个可扩展的5D神经代理模型，通过将层次化视觉Transformer扩展至5维来建模非线性回旋动理学等离子体湍流模拟，捕捉降阶模型忽略的物理现象，并准确估计湍流热输运。
en_tdlr: GyroSwin is the first scalable 5D neural surrogate that extends hierarchical Vision Transformers to 5D for modeling nonlinear gyrokinetic plasma turbulence simulations, capturing physical phenomena neglected by reduced-order models while providing accurate estimates of turbulent heat transport.
